title: Accessing One-Time Passwords for Enrolled Devices

blocks.text: You can view and copy the one-time password (OTP) for each enrolled device. You can use this OTP in place of passwords defined in app profiles.

OTPs consists of 10 random alphanumeric characters. The password remains in effect until it's used and can only be used once. After the password is used, a new password is auto-generated during the next policy update. This password is unique to the device and only the user of the device can use it.
To view and copy an OTP:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Device Overview.
Click the View icon () to view the device fingerprint for the enrolled device.
In the desired OTP field, click the Copy icon () to copy the one-time password.
